description: Four quantisers sharing seven twelve-note scales that can be edited by hand and are saved with the patch

params.text: Picks which of the seven scales the quantisers use; the seven start out as the modes of the major scale on C, from Ionian through to Locrian
Attenuates the scale input, narrowing how many scales 0-10V steps through
Attenuates the CV input of all four quantisers before they round it to a note
Turns that note on or off in the scale the scale knob has selected, and its lamp is lit while the note is on
Pre adds the transpose input to the incoming CV before quantising; post adds it to the quantised pitch, rounded to whole semitones

inputs.text: The voltage that quantiser rounds to the nearest note of the scale, carrying up to sixteen polyphonic channels
A rising edge takes a fresh reading of that quantiser's CV input; with nothing patched the quantiser follows its input continuously
Steps through the seven scales, 0-10V spanning all of them, added to the scale knob
Shifts the pitch by a volt per octave, before or after quantising as the pre and post switch sets

outputs.text: The quantised pitch of that channel, a volt per octave
A 1ms 10V pulse each time the quantised pitch of that channel changes to a new note
